member.summary: The text encoding to use

member.name: F:SwCurl.SwCurlParmas.FileMime

member.name: F:SwCurl.SwCurlParmas.Save
member.summary: An optional filename where the result will be saved. If the response has an error status, the status line is saved, ex: "<404> - Not found", followed by a new line and the response body (if any).

member.name: F:SwCurl.SwCurlParmas.SwRoot
member.summary: When logging in useing SysWeaver, the "root" of the service is required, by default this is the root of the supplied end point. In some cases a services may listen to a prefix that is not at the root. This parameters then contains the root (added to the root of the supplied end point).

member.name: F:SwCurl.SwCurlParmas.IgnoreCertErrors
